00_discovery.notes: signal-portfolio-commercial/docs/00_discovery.md reconciles package's own single-commit review against actual current app state (real HEAD ahead of package's inspected commit); confirms completed_trade_win_rate naming issue is real (tracked to Phase 03); confirms local disposable Postgres verified available; confirms no Supabase/Stripe/external accounts created.

01_rights_registry.notes: RightsGrant SQLAlchemy model + Pydantic schema (mirrors spec/contracts/RightsGrant.schema.json exactly), check_rights() fail-closed enforcement (no grant / wrong status / expired / not-yet-effective / channel-jurisdiction-asset not explicitly listed -> denied; empty list means nothing approved, never unrestricted; payment/subscription status is never a rights basis, structurally checked via signature inspection), seed_unknown_source() for the three named UNKNOWN providers (buyalerts, tradealgo, kamdenai). 15 tests, all passing against a real disposable Postgres cluster (tests/conftest.py). Load-bearing verification done: temporarily broke empty-channels-fail-closed, DENIED-status-fail-closed, and REVOKED-status-fail-closed one at a time, confirmed the corresponding test failed each time, restored exactly. ruff and mypy clean.
01_rights_registry.not_yet_wired: check_rights() has no callers yet -- Phases 04/05/06/07 must each call it again immediately before their own action, not cache an earlier result. Not yet exposed via any API route (Phase 02 has no routes yet either).

02_tenant_api_scaffold.notes: Tenant/UserIdentity/Membership/CustomerProfile models (app/models/tenancy.py); CustomerProfile's compound FK targets Membership(tenant_id, user_id), not just Tenant, so a mismatched (real tenant, real-but-unrelated user) pair is rejected by the database itself, not just application code (CP-012). Real Postgres row-level security (app/db.py's enable_row_level_security, FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY + a tenant_isolation policy keyed on the session's app.tenant_id) enforced against a genuine non-superuser, non-BYPASSRLS login role (app_role, tests/conftest.py) -- tests run as this role, since the postgres superuser bypasses RLS regardless of FORCE (CP-011). A controlled local JWT issuer (app/services/auth.py, PyJWT/HS256) for tests, fails closed on a tampered signature, expired token, unrecognized role, or missing tenant_id/user_id claim. An explicit role-permission allow-list (app/services/permissions.py, CP-013) covering the three named examples from docs/02 (billing_operator cannot release_strategy, researcher cannot grant_rights, customer cannot view_broker_credentials) plus fail-closed-by-default for any unlisted action. 35 tests total, all passing. Load-bearing verification done: broke the RLS policy body (USING (true)) and confirmed all three RLS tests failed; broke the CustomerProfile compound FK and confirmed the mismatched-pair test failed; both restored exactly. ruff and mypy clean.
02_tenant_api_scaffold.not_yet_wired: No FastAPI commercial_api routes/app entrypoint yet -- this phase built the data/auth/permission layer only. Supabase Auth/hosted login is unchanged -- still an external deployment task, not built here.

standing_constraints: Never place live orders or rotate live credentials.
No live publishing, customer charges, brokerage operations, purchases, production resets, or permission increases during build.
Payment is not a trading mandate; cancellation/payment failure must not abandon open exposure or auto-flatten.
No investment deposits through SaaS billing or improvised pooled wallets.
LLMs are optional reviewed aids only -- no rights, risk, fee, NAV, publishing, cross-tenant, or self-approval authority.
Missing drivers/credentials remain BLOCKED/NOT_RUN, never PASS.
Never paste passwords, customer documents, platform keys, or signed contracts into source control.
signal-copier/ (existing execution service) stays untouched by this build; separate Postgres database, never the owner's SQLite store or broker credentials.
Every test suite run must pass, and every load-bearing fix must be verified by temporarily breaking it and confirming a test catches the regression.
environment_facts_verified_this_session: postgresql-16 server binaries + psql client pre-installed; psycopg (v3) pip-installable; initdb/pg_ctl must run via `su postgres -c` since the sandbox runs as root; tmp_path_factory's ancestor dirs must have their execute bit opened (0711) for the postgres user to traverse down to a chowned data dir.
No Supabase/Stripe/broker-platform accounts exist or were created in this environment -- those remain external deployment tasks.
